The '''Serias expedition''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission to the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] conducted by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]. [[Korren Starchaser]] discovered some interesting [[Serianan runes|runes]] and [[Serianan statue|statues]] hidden in the [[Serianan Belt]].
